Martin is considered by others to be an unreliable individual. As a result, his ability to look after others has been called into question.

## History

Martin was hired as a worker at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) a year prior to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's death. During his time employed there, four cows died under his care.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)_
